title: Self-contained dist build with bin entry and channel detection
description: WHY: distribution requires an artifact that runs without the source checkout, tsx, or workspace node_modules resolution. The current shim (tools/install-local-bwrk.mjs) hard-depends on all three. WHAT: (1) add a bundling build for apps/cli that produces a self-contained dist (esbuild or equivalent) inlining all workspace packages, with a proper package bin entry pointing at the bundled entrypoint; keep the tsx shim for source-checkout development. (2) Teach the CLI its install channel - source, npm, or brew - detected at build time or from install metadata, reported in bwrk --version and available to doctor so upgrade advice is channel-correct; apps/cli/src/install-status.ts already inspects the shim and is the integration point. (3) Smoke test: run the bundled binary in a temp directory with no node_modules and execute init, work create, work list, doctor. Mind the runtime file assets (workflows, templates, schemas directories are read from the checkout today) - bundle or embed them and add a regression test that the bundle finds them.
acceptanceCriteria: Bundled binary passes the temp-directory smoke test with no source checkout present
bwrk --version reports the install channel and doctor gives channel-correct upgrade guidance
Workflow, template, and schema assets resolve from the bundle, covered by a test
